title: axonopus aureus var. pilosus
intro: Axonopus aureus var. pilosus, commonly known as  Golden Paspalum, is a type of grass that is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations. The health benefits of Axonopus aureus var. pilosus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its ability to protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit potential therapeutic applications in the treatment of various diseases.
